title: Left anodyne maps of simplicial sets
statement: Use small simplicial sets and standard horns as in [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones]. A simplicial map is left anodyne if it belongs to the smallest class containing all isomorphisms and the horn inclusions $\Lambda_i^n\hookrightarrow\Delta^n$ for $n\geq1$ and $0\leq i<n$, and closed under pushouts, transfinite compositions and retracts.
